esql: from * metadata _id, _index, _version | where (OperationNameValue in ("Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/listKeys/action", "Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/regenerateKey/action")) and ActivityStatusValue=="Success" and not (Caller in ("00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000a110", "allowlisted-key-rotation@example.com"))
golang_expr: (lower(OperationNameValue) == lower("Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/listKeys/action") or lower(OperationNameValue) == lower("Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/regenerateKey/action")) and lower(ActivityStatusValue) == lower("Success") and not (lower(Caller) == lower("00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000a110") or lower(Caller) == lower("allowlisted-key-rotation@example.com"))
sqlite: SELECT * FROM <TABLE_NAME> WHERE ((OperationNameValue='Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/listKeys/action' OR OperationNameValue='Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/regenerateKey/action') AND ActivityStatusValue='Success') AND (NOT (Caller='00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000a110' OR Caller='allowlisted-key-rotation@example.com'))
